renderer.formula: sha256(json.dumps({'canonicalization':CONTROLS.json['canonical'], 'preamble':<shared preamble text from render_arms._preamble(sample fixture)>, 'arm_templates':[(filename, sha256(filename)) for filename in arms/{canonical,store,render_arms,guard_constraints}.py + CONTROLS.json + run/driver.py (make_history)]}, sort_keys=True))

renderer_history.note: Rows written before this change carry old_digest. For the arm/render code the renderer is unchanged, so the current run's rows and the new digest describe the same renderer for arm code; however the history builder (make_history in run/driver.py) was unverified before this change, so identical history construction cannot be claimed for prior rows.
